name: Stearns Wharf
blurb: Santa Barbara's historic pier at the foot of State Street — seafood, souvenirs, and ocean views.

name: Santa Barbara County Courthouse
blurb: Spanish-Moorish architecture with a clock tower — climb for one of the best views over downtown.

name: Granada Theatre
blurb: A restored 1920s movie palace on State Street — films, concerts, and a glowing marquee at night.

name: Arlington Theatre
blurb: An indoor-outdoor theatre on State Street — built inside a former mortuary chapel with stars on the ceiling.

name: Funk Zone
blurb: Murals, wine tasting, and galleries between the freeway and the beach — artsy blocks off State.

name: El Presidio de Santa Bárbara
blurb: The last Spanish fort in California — adobe walls and a chapel a short walk from State Street.

name: MOXI Museum
blurb: Hands-on science and creativity near the train station — rooftop views toward the mountains.

name: Paseo Nuevo
blurb: Open-air shopping on State Street — courtyards, fountains, and stores under Spanish-style arches.
